honest_limitations: 60-turn hand-authored corpus is small; κ noise band ≈ ±0.1 at N=60.
LLM judge sees no client context (empty tuple) — apples-to-apples with lexical _mirror_hit which also sees only the companion turn.
LLM judge is a second lexical-register classifier at a semantic level, not ground truth; disagreement bounds the ceiling, not the floor.
The author-intuition target_bond field from CALIBRATION_CORPUS is NOT used here — only the companion_turns field.

interpretation.lex0_llm1: semantic-empathy cases lexical misses — the κ-ceiling gap in the under-count direction
interpretation.lex1_llm0: cue-token false positives — lexical fires on a token the semantic judge does not read as empathic
interpretation.kappa_band: chance-corrected agreement; raw agreement alone is misleading when one path is sparse
